reviews.t: Works good for holding isopropyl alcohol
reviews.x: Bought this because I do some electronics repairs which require me to clean an area before working on it. I use Isopropyl alcohol to do so, and needed a good way to apply the solution to the work area accurately. This fits the bill perfectly. The needle tip is very fine which lets me apply exactly the right amount, and also prevents the alcohol from evaporating. I've had one of these sitting on my bench full of alcohol for about 2 months without being used and I don't think its gone down half a

These applicator bottles with blunt needles on top are useful in myriad ways. I like putting my artists' inks and mediums in as well as using it for application of small amounts of water to paint mixing. Very good bottles!
The 25ga needle is too narrow for anything but the thinnest, lightest-weight oils.  Bottle is good quality.

reviews.t: I do not recommend this. I usually am very positive and purchase ...
reviews.x: I am an artist and this product did not work for me.  I put fluid liquid acrylic paint in it and when I squeeze the bottle nothing came out.... I tried over and over again.  I couldn't get it out of the nozzle. The nozzle is extremely small ... I think too small for paint to come out of it.  I do not recommend this.  I usually am very positive and purchase from amazon all the time.  But this is defective and I would never purchase it again.

Perfect for many products, but I use it for my alcohol when working with alcohol inks.  I also use water in it for acrylics or watercolor when I want them to drip and run.  Great little product. Interesting little history on how it was named "oiler boiler."

I got this to do delicate oiling but for the oil I'm using you have to squeeze the bottle really hard to get a tiny drop out. With a very light machine oil it might work but not with medium bodied oil.
I use these for applying many different fluids and glues in my work. Quality is good and the price is reasonable. They work well and I would be happy to buy more when the time comes.
I bought this to use for my alcohol inks. Makes it easier to dispense smaller amounts and creates a different design, I love this!

reviews.t: Use to fill in roll marks AR15
reviews.x: These worked very well for what I bought them for. Very small needle, is small enough to fill in roll marks on an AR15 with out much mess. Some roll marks I was able to fill without having to wipe up any excess paint. I used Testors paint because its a very watery paint so it had no problems flowing through the needle. As for clean up, all I did was fill the bottle with a little bit of thinner and then squeeze the thinner through the needle to make sure no paint residue was left.

I wanted this for applying acrylic cement which has the consistency of water. Unfortunately due to the way it's constructed, it doesn't fulfil this function.  The needle is attached to the cap via a circlip. Unfortunately the seal leaks meaning it is impossible to control the rate at which the liquid exits the needle tip.  I'm thinking that I might be able to seal it some other way but it is a disappointment for a new out of the box item.

This is just what I was looking for in a pin point oiler. First of all I wanted to use my own lubricant, and second I wanted a high degree of accuracy when using the product. This item serves both my needs perfectly and it was reasonably priced. It has a quality syringe style needle protector, seems to be made well, and doesn't leak. For intricate oiling of small parts I have found what I needed.

reviews.t: Feed the tiniest of Sarracenia seedlings!!!
reviews.x: These are perfect for fertilizing small carnivorous pitcher plant seedlings. Just fill it up with your Maxsea solution, put the needle down it’s gullet, and squeeze!  Your seedlings will thank you and mature years before they would without this treatment!  Get yourself some and be the envy of all your friends!

reviews.t: Not made to use with glue
reviews.x: If using for the purpose they were intended (paint), they probably work great. I wanted to use it with Crystal Accents for very fine application.  Glue doesn't want to come out. Glad I only put a small amount in the bottle.
I purchased this to better apply the liquid Frog Lube in tight spaces.  It does a great job and suits the purpose well.
Using to place a precise amount of paint thinner on an oil palette instead of dabbing with an oily brush.  Works great.
The cap doesn't make a good seal with the bottle and causes leaking. Makes it useless, unfortunately.
First time using the ink bled from the top of the bottle. Totally unusable. Not a great product.
Good product I use constantly with alcohol inks for slowing adding rubbing alcohol to a craft.
Bought to use with Alcohol Ink art application. It will do just what I want it to do.

reviews.t: Ummm, Yeah, I don't know about this thing
reviews.x: I ordered and received to be used for painting small thin lines.  I tested it with water...nothing came out!  I've not located any type of seal that would prevent ligiid from coming through the needle. I've watched youtube videos on how to prepare this little bottle with a long needle, but mine just doesn't' work

Got 2 of these, different syringe diameters. Can't recall if this is the smaller one or not. Used it with TriFlow oil for oiling my various sewing machines and it works perfectly (well, one of the domes, the other is still in the package). Well made and no leaks.
I fix cell phones as a side hustle. With the use of 97% rubbing alcohol, you're able to get those hard to reach areas. Worked as expected and will buy again if the bottle ever breaks.
I am using this as a pinpoint oil dispenser.  The fine needle makes it extremely easy to oil hard to reach areas and dispense just the right amount of oil.  Great little bottle!
I have been looking for these for awhile. We apply pins to name badges in bulk and these bottles work perfect to apply the solvent. This liquids will work perfect.
Works well for delivering light oil to hard to reach gears and pivots in a clock. The plastic's kinda thin - so you might expect to replace it in a few years.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the fine needle tip ideal for precise application of thin liquids like alcohol, inks, water, and watery paints.
Several users report the needle is too narrow for thicker fluids such as medium-bodied oils, acrylic paint, and glue, which clog or barely dispense.
Reviewers praise the overall bottle quality, reasonable price, and usefulness across many different tasks.
Some users note the cap/needle seal leaks, making it hard to control the flow rate.
